assets.title: The Earth
assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: transparent product PNG for the The Earth card in a luxury jewelry atelier website. Output a single portrait image, exactly 1024 × 1280 pixels (4:5), with genuine alpha transparency everywhere outside the jewelry or mineral specimen, including internal gaps. This is a floating cutout, photographed without any visible support, workbench, floor, background color, backdrop, vignette or cast shadow. Keep fine edges and realistic photographic materials. Match a coherent series of velvety vivid Colombian greens, warm polished 18k yellow gold, and brilliant white diamonds.

Primary request: A raw, uncut Colombian emerald crystal cluster growing out of a small piece of dark grey-black shale and white calcite matrix. Hexagonal prismatic emerald crystals with natural striations, flat terminations and a slightly frosted, glassy surface. Deep velvety green with natural inclusions ("jardin"), translucent at the edges where light passes through. Three to four crystals of varying size, the tallest in the centre, angled slightly. Real mineral-specimen photography style.
